what_this_is: One Workshop search owner over every account list and file, with narrow scoped-list and HTTP adapters and index builders. Semantic rankers live under meaning; the engine supplies storage only.

payload.label: Search everything I keep
payload.job: Find anything in my account with one question across every list and file, by what was said, seen, named or written
payload.description: One question over every list and file in this account. Combines record text, file names, literal transcript and document text, and each installed semantic index. Results are fused by rank, never by scores across models, with addresses, places (said, seen, name, written), timed moments and their original evidence scores. Discovers semantic-index-descriptor rows automatically; no index choice is needed. places and sources narrow the requested search. unavailable names every source or model that could not answer; pending names work still in progress. A missing model leaves literal words usable. Only read access is granted.

question.description: The person's question or the words to find

limit.description: The most results (60 when left out)

index_ids.description: Optionally restrict file-content search to these installed indexes; discovery is automatic when omitted.

query_vectors.description: Optional encoded queries from a model. Each vector is used only for indexes with the exact same model identity; other models still encode the question.

payload.label: Search everything I keep with one question (runs in a small container)
payload.job: Search every list, record and file name I keep with one question, in one ranked list, without my own computer
payload.description: Searches everything this person keeps with one question, as a Workshop run: every kind of record (each kind ranked as its own lane) and their files by name, merged by reciprocal rank into one list, best first. Each result has found_in (written for a record's text, name for a file's name), said (the words around the match), score and address (records:read for a record, find_file for a file). The run holds two read-only rights and nothing else: records:search over every kind ({kind: "*"}, which covers only a search that names no kind and never a write) and the files' name search over every name. unavailable names a lane that could not answer and why; pending names one still working.

question.description: The person's question or the words to find

limit.description: The most results (60 when left out)

payload.label: Search one of my lists with one question
payload.job: Find the rows of one of my lists that hold the words I ask, best match first, however far down the list they are
payload.description: Searches the records of one kind (one list) with one question through the records door's word index, which every write feeds: the rows holding every asked word, best first, each with said (the words around the match), score and address (the records:read that opens it). The whole list is searched in one call, never one page at a time. This run is granted that one kind only; to search every list and the files together, use tool:search-everything-with-one-question.

type.description: The kind of record (the list) to search; this run's right is filled from it
